recommendations: **Slabs are physically accessible:** observed real ascents. Compare entry stalls and completion rates before changing slab route costs.
**Door-entry hesitation observed:** check collision-safe alignment and congestion at door lips; require the real-controller no-jump regression to pass.
**Door routes were attempted:** compare completion times of door users versus other routes before assigning a larger door preference.
**Final generation regressed from the session best.** Keep the protected champion and individual top-three pool, then test gene changes against repeated identical conditions.
**Speed target not met:** optimize reliable 10/10 completion under 260 ticks before accepting faster individual records as team-wide improvement.

**Knowledge pool unchanged:** new physical generations did not beat the retained personal-best leaders. Prefer controlled motor/strategy experiments instead of counting generation increments as improvement.
